name: design-doc-rules
description: Rules and a runnable checker that strip machine-flavoured prose from design documents, proposals, technical docs, and slide decks in Korean or English.

interface.shortDescription: Write design docs that read like a person wrote them.
interface.longDescription: Five sections of rules plus check.sh, a grep-based checker that flags machine-flavoured prose in Korean or English design documents, proposals, technical docs, and slide decks.
defaultPrompt: Review this design doc against the design-doc rules.
Rewrite this section to pass check.sh.
